To address this, we investigate ternary language models (TriLMs) that employ quantization-aware training to significantly reduce memory requirements.
Based on this observation, we introduce TriTera, an open suite of TriLMs trained on up to 1.2 trillion tokens, demonstrating sustained performance gains at scale.
Building on the 2-bit packing, we develop a GPU kernel called TriRun that accelerates end-to-end model inference by up to 5 \times compared to floating-point baselines.
